name: PvP Essentials
summary: One pack for PvP: a clean dot crosshair, visible ores, smaller swords, low fire and a clear pumpkin.
body:
**PvP Essentials** is a client-side resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition. It changes one specific thing about the vanilla look, and nothing else.

### What it changes
- A clean 1px dot crosshair (replaces the vanilla crosshair)
- Visible ores - every ore and ancient debris stands out
- Smaller swords, so your weapon stops covering the middle of the screen
- Low fire - the flame sits lower with the full animation, in the world and in the GUI
- Clear pumpkin - no orange blur when wearing one

### Why players use it
- Everything above comes from five separate packs and is bundled here so you install it once
- Each feature keeps working like its original pack, this is just the all-in-one convenience build

### Install
1. Download the `.zip` file from this page (do not unzip it).
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks` - or use the CurseForge app.
3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs** and move it to the top of the list.

Works on Minecraft **1.21.x** (Java Edition) and on most launchers. Client-side only: it works on any server, and no one else needs it.

---

### Get the whole set
This is part of the **PvP Essentials** family - the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin: [PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)

Liked it? You can support the work on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/fliflight).

version.changelog: Low fire fixed: the flame is now fully lowered (compressed, tip preserved) instead of cut off at the top. Both fire layers lowered; GUI overlay included.
